title: Modular Micro-Reactors – The Future of Nuclear Energy?
summary: Professor Ruzic explains modular micro-reactors: self-contained nuclear units with passive safety whose fuel lasts about 20 years. He covers their use for process and district heat and where they can compete with diesel generation.
why: Recommended as a clear technical explanation of micro-reactor fuel, safety and economics, from a channel HN trusts on nuclear topics.

quote.text: His videos are great. Worth your time.
